decision: Maker evidence only; parent acceptance is pending and this report does not self-accept the work.

screenshots.viewportInterpretation: Pixel regions below are approximate manual review boxes in the raw live-scene screenshots, origin at upper left. Exact projected bounds are called out where available.

anchors.requirement: Recognizable white/ivory desk and blue-and-white chair; keep resident from hiding workstation.
anchors.desktopObservation: Desk and blue chair are readily recognizable. Resident and chair back overlap the center-right desk and hide part of the work surface.
anchors.mobileObservation: Desk and chair are recognizable; chair and resident dominate the foreground and overlap part of the right setup.

anchors.requirement: Prominent recognizable pink/lilac hex light cluster.
anchors.desktopObservation: The wall reads as a pale geometric/white patch. No distinct lilac hex silhouettes or pink/lilac grouping are recognizable in the actual rendered pixels.
anchors.mobileObservation: The wall and hex region wash to near-white; no recognizable lilac cluster.
anchors.limitation: The packet does not authorize runtime edits to per-material emissive strength, and GLB/material bytes were preserved. Named-light/exposure calibration did not make the required shapes/color recognizable.

sourceGeometry: Light_CyanFill and cyan fill light nodes in the accepted scene
anchors.desktopObservation: A cyan pool is visible under the desk on the floor, though dimmer and more localized than the supplied reference.
anchors.mobileObservation: A cyan floor pool remains visible below the chair/desk.

anchors.requirement: Central monitor with two speakers visible as a workstation grouping.
anchors.desktopObservation: The central monitor is recognizable. Left speaker is visible; the right speaker is obscured/merged with the monitor/resident grouping, so the required two-speaker group is not recognizable.
anchors.mobileObservation: The monitor is small but recognizable; speakers are tiny and do not read as a clear pair.

anchors.desktopObservation: The bar is a narrow dark/neutral horizontal strip above the display; it does not read as warm light.
anchors.mobileObservation: The bar is too small and appears neutral/dark rather than warm.

anchors.requirement: Plant/shelf grouping with a recognizable camera resting on the shelf.
sourceGeometry: ai-real-camera root with 7 mesh descendants: ai_cam_chassis, ai_cam_hub, ai_cam_leg_1, ai_cam_leg_2, ai_cam_leg_3, ai_cam_lens_barrel, ai_cam_status_ring
anchors.cameraSourceTransform: The ai-real-camera root is mesh-null at authored origin; descendant geometry is present around authored x=-1.45, y=1.70. Runtime root translation is [0.7, 0.35, 0.18].
anchors.desktopObservation: The left plant is clipped. The shelf is a thin high horizontal line. The camera descendants render but read as a small block hanging immediately below the shelf rather than a convincing shelf camera.
anchors.mobileObservation: The plant is mostly clipped and the camera projects to about 12.7 x 19.4 pixels; it appears only as a tiny glyph near the shelf line.
anchors.visualStatus: FAIL: in-frustum and rendered, but not recognizable/convincingly placed at this scale.
anchors.interactionStatus: PASS: source binding still targets ai-real-camera; clicking the rendered group navigated to /projects/ai-vs-real in the focused production browser test.

anchors.requirement: Console/microphone grouping to the left of the monitor.
sourceGeometry: talks-microphone root with 6 mesh descendants; source audit did not find a named console node
anchors.desktopObservation: The microphone is visible. The required console portion is not identified in the accepted GLB node inventory, so the complete left console/microphone grouping cannot be confirmed.
anchors.mobileObservation: Microphone/desk detail is small and the console is not recognizable.

anchors.requirement: Recognizable PC and controller objects attached to the right-side pegboard.
sourceGeometry: one controller assembly: peg_controller_accent, peg_controller_body, peg_controller_mount
anchors.sourceDimensions: The source contains one pale controller assembly; its body is approximately 0.16 x 0.10 x 0.04 m. It was not duplicated.
anchors.desktopObservation: Pegboard holes are visible; the single controller is a tiny pale mark. The PC tower is partly visible but the resident/chair overlaps the workstation grouping.
anchors.mobileObservation: Pegboard and PC are partially visible at the right edge; controller is too small/unclear to recognize and chair/resident occlude the lower grouping.

anchors.requirement: Secondary right-side headset stand, only if none exists in accepted GLB.

anchors.mobileObservation: The support is partly clipped at the right edge and is not recognizable as a headset stand.
